products.title: The Garden Buddy
products.descriptionHtml:
The all-in-one kneeler, seat and tool set for a happier, easier time in the garden.

Kneel on the thick pad. Push up on the handles when you are done. Flip the whole frame over and it is a stool for potting and pruning. It arrives assembled and folds flat for the shed.

Add the 10-piece tool set in a bundle and the bag, the stool, the tools, the gloves and the sprayer come with it.

seo.title: The Garden Buddy — Foldable Garden Kneeler Seat with Handles
seo.description: A padded garden kneeler that flips into a stool, with handles that help you stand back up. Arrives assembled, folds flat. Free US shipping, 30-day returns.

products._pricingLogic: Compare-at is real arithmetic, never invented. Garden Buddy lists at 99.99 and the tool set at 59.99, so: 69.99 = 30% off, 99.99 off 159.98 = 37% off, 129.99 off 259.97 = 50% off.

products.title: Garden Buddy 10-Piece Tool Set
products._why: Deliberately draft. It is bundle-only and must never have a storefront page of its own. Its 59.99 price exists so the bundle compare-at maths is honest.
products.descriptionHtml:
Ten pieces: a folding stool, a bag that holds everything, six steel hand tools, claw gloves and a sprayer.

The bag hangs on the stool frame. Carry the whole thing out to the bed in one hand, sit down, and every tool is already at your side instead of back in the shed.

Tools are stainless heads on rubber-grip handles with a hanging hole in the end. The stool is a black steel frame with a canvas seat and it folds flat.
